title: Pete Capitán — EN/IT/PT (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word 105bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal English Italian Portuguese language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Dad saved his number under Pete Capitán
Not the first name, not the surname — just the man
What's in a name? Everything, Chas would say
The Captain's always there at the start of the day

[Verse 2 — Italiano]
Figlio maggiore di sette anni e ancora di più [Oldest son by seven years and counting]
Primo a tavola, primo ad alzarsi di su [First to the table, first up in the morning]
Il rugby nel sangue e l'aria salata nel petto [Rugby in his blood and salt air in his chest]
Chas lo mise nel telefono — e quello disse tutto il resto [Chas put it in the phone — and that said all the rest]

[Chorus — English]
Pete Capitán, first over the line
Pete Capitán, been leading since nine
Rooftop to the ocean, hammer to the helm
Pete Capitán — it's always been your realm

[Bridge — Português]
Corey está no meio, Joel fecha a fila [Corey's in the middle, Joel brings up the rear]
Mas os dois sabem quem deu o tom à família [But they both know who set the tone for the family]
Não se ganha o Capitán do pai ficando parado [You don't earn Capitán from your dad by sitting still]
Ganha-se no telhado, ganha-se na ondulada [You earn it on the rooftop, you earn it on the swell]

[Verse 3 — English]
Live wire never quits, oldest never stops
Pete Capitán — from the rooftop to the docks

[Outro — EN/IT/PT]
Pete Capitán
Pete Capitán
That's my boy
Questo è il mio ragazzo [That's my boy]
Esse é o meu filho [That's my boy]
